title: SalesPatriot podcast with Mark Lyons from Statz Corporation (Hosted by Nelson Ray)
summary: We deploy AI into supply chains that the West depends on.
body_markdown: Mark is a retired Army 1SG and Disabled Veteran with more than 20 years as a Cavalry Scout and Paratrooper with several deployments worldwide. Mark’s education includes an M.B.A. in Business Administration from Cardinal Stritch University, a Bachelor of Science in Marketing from Columbia Southern University and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt from Villanova. Mark’s career in management, leadership and supply chain management/development will prove invaluable to our customers, suppliers and the STATZ Corporation Team. Mark wants STATZ to be all about the Warfighters and takes STATZ’s mission seriously for our great nation.
